changes.comment: Channel providers may now serve their own Commands. A ChannelInstance can compose an optional ChannelCommandCapability beside its session, whose definitions() returns ChannelCommandDefinition values authored like host Commands but naming only a single stable local_name; the host encodes the channel id and derives the registered name channel.<encoded channel_id>.<local_name> from it. Both types are additive and optional, so an existing Channel provider compiles unchanged.
